patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than LeadIQ's shape. Choose LeadIQ only if your buying job matches “Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pr” rather than Gong's shape. Workflow advantage: Gong leans sales-engagement; LeadIQ leans prospecting, data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list).; LeadIQ is Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pro from $200/mo..
- Company-size focus: Gong (mid-market, enterprise) vs LeadIQ (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gong-leaning sales-engagement vs LeadIQ-leaning prospecting, data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; LeadIQ — Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools.

Limitations — Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core; LeadIQ: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools; Native email sequencing depth is limited versus dedicated engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Gong is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases · LeadIQ is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools · Avoid Gong if you actually need LeadIQ's motion (Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 c)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
